state:
**Goal `tooling-overhaul`: Stages 9 to 11 are done, and Stage 12 (`no Python`) is under way.** The cutover is on `main`. `main` stays frozen, and tag `pre-overhaul` is the rollback.

`bun nv audit python` (`tools/nv/cmd/audit.ts`) is Stage 12's check, and its output is the list still to clear: 5 `.py` files (`tools/disk.py`, `tools/observe.py`, `tools/proctree.py`, `tools/written.py`, `editors/vscode/scripts/mkwoff.py`) and 98 documents. Two calls it makes, which the user may overrule: the Python twins under `benches/userland/` are not tools, because `bun nv bench` runs them as the Python engine's workload, so they stay; and a "document" is tracked Markdown outside `docs/decisions/`, `CHANGELOG.md` and the prose of every goal the chain has reached. The module doc owns the definition.

No code comment, README, rule, playbook bullet or setup page names a deleted tool (`peek`, `bench`, `bench-load`, `bench-proxied`, `db-matrix`, `origin`) any more. The one file left that does is `docs/agent/commands.md`, which item 1 below rewrites. Frozen records and reached goals' prose still name them, as the audit allows. Only the `disk` parity group is left, so `tools/nv/cmd/parity.ts` stays until `tools/disk.py` goes. `proof.py`, `side.py` and the unscoped part of `brief.py` have no port; `bun nv orient --full` is the nearest to the last.

An untracked `tools/nv/driver/proctree.ts` (and `console.ts`, `transcript.ts`, with `launch.ts` modified) was on disk during this session and is not from any session commit. It looks like by-hand driver work, so leave it alone unless it is committed.
